title: Our Future Health — Genotype array data — SNV VCF
description: Array of Our Future Health genetic data records. One element is one record of the genotype array SNV VCF files (ofh_snv.v10.chrZ-bXXXX.vcf.gz): the genotype of one sample at one variant with that variant's allele count and total alleles.
$comment: Describes the columns of the source file as a table of rows; the files themselves are TSV, text or VCF (D124). A value absent in the source is -998 (the string "-998" for text), D021. Cross-table links to participant.PID cannot be enforced (D102).
